# NeoSatoshi Card Recognition API

> Card recognition API for Pokémon, One Piece, Disney Lorcana, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Magic: The Gathering, Star Wars: Unlimited, Digimon Card Game and football (soccer) cards: send a photo, get JSON with set, number, rarity, Cardmarket ID and daily prices. Made by NeoSatoshi (NeoGen Solutions GmbH, Bern, Switzerland).

## Call

* Endpoint: POST https://europe-west1-neosatoshi.cloudfunctions.net/detectApi
* Header: Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>
* Public demo key (intentionally public, no signup, 10 detections per day per network): nsk_live_9c253fbed995042a98280ad13e5c47d3c4a59c9b4f0f7274
* Body (JSON): {"image": "<base64 JPEG or PNG, max 12 MB>", "tcg": "pokemon"}
* Alternative body: {"image_url": "https://...", "tcg": "pokemon"} (public https URL to a JPEG or PNG, max 12 MB)
* tcg values: pokemon (default), onepiece, lorcana, yugioh, magic, star_wars_unlimited, digimon, football
* Default: one JSON body. One card usually takes about 4 seconds, about 10 to 12 seconds on the first request after a quiet period; a binder page with 9 cards about 17 seconds. Client timeout: at least 120 seconds.
* Optional streaming: add "stream": true (or the header Accept: text/event-stream) to get Server-Sent Events: accepted, progress, card (each card as soon as it is recognised), then done (the same body as the JSON response) or error. Same cost. A reconnect is a new, charged detection.

## Games and card languages

* Pokémon (pokemon): English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese. Several cards per photo, binder pages work, best up to about 20.
* One Piece (onepiece): English, Japanese. Several cards per photo, binder pages work.
* Disney Lorcana (lorcana): English, German, French, Italian. Several cards per photo, binder pages work.
* Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG (yugioh): English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese. Not OCG. Several cards per photo, binder pages work.
* Magic: The Gathering (magic): English, German, French, Italian, Spanish. Several cards per photo, binder pages work.
* Star Wars: Unlimited (star_wars_unlimited): English, German, French, Italian, Spanish. Several cards per photo, binder pages work.
* Digimon Card Game (digimon): English, Japanese. Several cards per photo, binder pages work. Recognised by card number and name; alternative arts share the number, the printing comes from the picture or is picked from the alternatives. Older Digimon products (the 1999 card game, the 2000 trading cards) are not recognised.
* One game per photo: send the matching tcg.
* Football (soccer) cards (football): Topps, Panini and other makers. One card front per photo, JPEG or PNG up to 4 MB, about 6 to 25 seconds. No card language.

## Response

{request_id, count, cards[], credits{remaining}} for your own key; the public demo key gets demo{limit_per_day, remaining_today} instead of credits.

Each card: name, language, tcg (absent for Pokémon), set{id, ptcgo_code or code, name, number}, rarity, cardmarket_id, prices{cardmarket{trend, low, avg7, avg30, currency EUR}, tcgplayer (USD, where available)}, images{small, large}, confidence (0 to 1), image_quality{blurred, unusual_dimensions}, alternatives[].

Game-specific: Pokémon name_ja, name_ko, name_zh, reverse_holo, first_edition, special_variant. One Piece card_id (for example OP01-003). Lorcana version, full_name, name_en, prices.cardmarket_foil. Yu-Gi-Oh! passcode, set.code, edition, price_versions, *_unconfirmed flags. Magic printing, prices.cardmarket_foil, TCGplayer foil price. Digimon card_key (the card number, for example BT1-025), print_id (the printing, for example BT1-025_P1), name_en, type, level, colors, set.code, variant, parallel_index, finishes, print_unconfirmed, number_unconfirmed; card_id is dg-<print_id> (English), dg-ja-<print_id> (Japanese) or dg-c-<number> while the printing is open (no price then, the printings come as alternatives, each priced); Cardmarket prices for English and Japanese printings, TCGplayer for English only. Football card_id (fb-...), season, subset, teams, rookie, card_type, sure, score, parallel{pick (only when sure), candidates[{name, print_run}], serial_number}; prices and images are null for football (no football prices yet).

Graded slabs (PSA, BGS, CGC; football also SGC): graded{grader, grade, cert_number, label} as read from the label, null for a raw card. Never an estimated grade.

A missing price is null, never 0.

## Errors

JSON {error, message}. 400 missing_image, bad_image, image_too_large, unsupported_image, unsupported_tcg, bad_image_url, image_url_fetch_failed. 401 missing_api_key, invalid_api_key. 402 out_of_credits. 405 method_not_allowed. 422 no_card_detected, unreadable_image (football) (not charged). 429 rate_limited, demo_limit_reached, football_busy (5 football photos in progress per key). 502 backend step failed (retry). 503 football_daily_limit (resets_at), football_unavailable (football only, not charged). 504 detection_timeout (retry).

## Card search and corrections

* Base: https://europe-west1-neosatoshi.cloudfunctions.net/cardsApi, same Bearer key, all seven trading card games and football.
* Correct a wrong card (free, 24 hours): every card has "card_index", the response has "correction" with "request_id". POST /search with {"request_id", "card_index", "q": "<card name>"} (or "set" + "number") returns up to 5 full card objects, then POST /corrections with {"request_id", "card_index", "card_id"} returns the corrected card. 5 searches and 3 corrections per card.
* Card search (paid): POST /search with {"tcg": "pokemon", "q": "charizard 4/102"} (or "set" + "number", optional "language", "limit" up to 10); GET /cards/{tcg}/{card_id} returns one card. 0.5 credits per call that returns a card, no result is free, Idempotency-Key header makes a repeat free. Demo key: 10 searches and 3 lookups per day per network.
* Digimon search: a card number alone is a query ({"tcg": "digimon", "q": "BT1-025"}, BT1-025_P1 for a printing), language en or ja. GET /cards/digimon/dg-BT1-025_P1 returns a printing, dg-c-BT1-025 the card with its printings.
* Football search: POST /search with {"tcg": "football", "q": "kane chrome 2023"} (the player, optional set or season words; no language, no prices yet). Each result has "ref"; GET /cards/football/{card_id}?ref=... (same key, within 24 hours) returns the card with all parallels of its subset and their print runs. Football detections cannot be corrected yet.

## Pricing

Own API keys: dashboard settings at https://neosatoshi.com/dashboard/settings/settings#api-keys, any paid plan (smallest: Start-Up, 19 per month, 1,000 card scans included). One credit per detected card. Images without a card are not charged.

## Not supported

Card condition grading. The API identifies cards; it does not judge condition.

## Links

* Documentation: https://neosatoshi.com/developers/detection-api
* OpenAPI spec: https://neosatoshi.com/openapi.json (copy in this repository: openapi.json)
* MCP server: mcp-server/ in this repository, npm package neosatoshi-card-mcp (stdio). Setup: claude mcp add neosatoshi-cards -e NEOSATOSHI_API_KEY=your_key -- npx -y neosatoshi-card-mcp . Tools: recognize_cards, recognize_folder (a folder of photos to CSV or JSON), search_cards, correct_card, get_card, export_cards (detections to the same file the website exports: custom CSV/JSON, TCGPowerTools, Shopify or eBay CSV; free, own key), list_export_presets, list_supported_games. Without a key it uses the demo key. Official MCP registry name: io.github.Cookiebreed/card-recognition-mcp.
* Terms: https://neosatoshi.com/termsofuse
* Contact: api@neosatoshi.com
